1) 从告警标签取 consumergroup 与 topic，执行 kafka: 1) Take consumergroup and topic from the alert labels and run kafka-consumer-groups.sh --describe --group <group> --bootstrap-server <broker> to see the LAG distribution per partition; 2) Lag concentrated on a few partitions means data skew — check the partition key on the producer side; 3) Evenly spread lag means consumers are slow: first check the consumer logs for abnormal retries, then scale out consumer instances (never beyond the partition count) or make per-message processing faster; 4) Confirm the consumers have not all dropped out (MEMBERS at 0 means you must start the consumers first).
1) 从告警标签取 topic，执行 kafka-topics.sh --des: 1) Take topic from the alert labels and run kafka-topics.sh --describe --topic <topic> --bootstrap-server <broker>, comparing Isr against Replicas to find which broker holds the missing replica; 2) Check that broker's server.log for a full disk, GC pauses or network timeouts; 3) If the broker is down, bring it back and the replicas will catch up automatically; 4) If it cannot catch up for a long time, use kafka-reassign-partitions.sh to move the replica to a healthy broker.
1) 执行 kafka-broker-api-versions.sh --boo: 1) Run kafka-broker-api-versions.sh --bootstrap-server <broker> to list the currently online brokers and compare against the configuration to find the missing node; 2) On that node, confirm the process is alive and check server.log for OOM or disk errors; 3) After bringing it back, run kafka-topics.sh --describe --under-replicated-partitions to confirm the replicas caught up; 4) If the node cannot be fixed soon, use kafka-reassign-partitions.sh to move its partitions away and restore redundancy.

Runbook for out-of-sync replicas
1. Restart the Zookeeper leader.

有分区处于副本未同步（under-replicated）状态，该分区已失去冗余，: Some partitions are under-replicated; those partitions have lost redundancy, and losing one more broker means data loss or an unwritable partition.
消费组积压消息数超过 1 万条，消费能力跟不上生产速度，下游看到的数据延迟会持续: Consumer group lag is above 10000 messages: consumption cannot keep up with production, and the data delay seen downstream will keep growing.
集群在线 broker 数量在 10 分钟内减少，说明有 broker 掉线，分: The number of online brokers in the cluster dropped within 10 minutes, which means a broker went offline; partition leaders will be re-elected and both produce and consume will be disrupted meanwhile.
